summary: Season 1 Points finalization is verified; Stability Pool recovery and broader finding reconciliation remain open. Vault 158 recovery source is merged and PR #618 pins the upgrade-only candidate and recipient readback. ckSOL PR #610 is draft: direct running upgrades can trap callbacks, so stop/drain is the practical mitigation; other deploy paths remain unprotected and the reserve stays off. XRP deposit guidance is deployed.
plainSummary: Season 1 rewards are finalized and the XRP deposit guidance is live. Vault 158 recovery software and its plan are ready, but the live bot remains unchanged. ckSOL stays in draft review; stop/drain tests passed locally, other upgrade paths still need protection, and its reserve remains off.

The configured destination that must be read back and confirmed before a recovery payment is allowed.
